Subject: Zenlytics POC: success criteria & trial plan

Thanks for the time today

great discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the POC kickoff. Please reply with any adjustments.

High-level goal:
- Evaluate Redwood inference runtime for Zenlytics production workload to confirm latency, throughput, and extraction accuracy for your key flows.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
- Latency: 95th percentile < 350ms server-side for typical prompt lengths (target client-side end-to-end < 400ms)
- Throughput: sustain 50 req/s with concurrency profile X (we'll validate with your replayed traffic)
- Extraction quality: entity extraction F1 >= 0.88 on your labelled sample set
- Cost guardrails: baseline per-token cost estimate and 15% improvement opportunity via batching/caching

Evaluation plan & scope:
- Duration: 2 weeks (kickoff -> baseline -> optimization -> go/no-go)
- Data: you provide a 2k-sample evaluation set and redaction rules; Redwood will ingest and run evaluation prompts + metrics dashboard
- Deployment: dedicated trial instance (reserved capacity) configurable to match your production CPU/GPU class
- Ownership: Marissa (AM) runbook/coordination, Marcus (SE) infra & tuning, Priya (Zenlytics) product owner for datasets and acceptance tests

Timeline (proposed):
- Thu Dec 3: you share sample dataset and acceptance prompts
- Mon Dec 7: kickoff + infra provisioning (1 hour)
- Week 1 (Dec 7-Dec 11): baseline runs, initial metrics
- Week 2 (Dec 14-Dec 18): tuning, performance optimizations, final acceptance
- Mon Dec 21: go/no-go decision and next steps

Attachments: attached POC scope + trial playbook for reference.
[attachment: zenlytics_poc_scope_v1.pdf] [attachment: redwood_trial_playbook.docx]

Immediate asks:
1) Confirm the success criteria above (particularly latency and F1 targets)
2) Can you share the sample dataset and acceptance prompts by Thu Dec 3?
3) Confirm availability for kickoff on Mon Dec 7 (we can shift to Tue Dec 8 if needed)

Thanks
Marissa Cole
